objective: Turn the local websiteResolverServiceV1 prototype and W64 drawer adapter into a production deployment plan.
whyNotProductionGoYet: W66 proved Trek can resolve from live website evidence.
W66 also proved Patagonia and Grainger remain thin from public resolver responses and Lincoln Electric remains blocked.
A hosted endpoint is required for consistent network environment, cache behavior, observability, rate limiting, and controlled pilot rollout.
Five-consultant pilot should not rely on Tampermonkey-only fetching.

roles.name: Resolver Service Architect
roles.owns: Hosted endpoint shape, deployment topology, cache, retry policy, service contract, and drawer adapter wiring.

roles.name: Security Guard
roles.owns: Endpoint auth, CORS, SSRF controls, scheme/domain policy, blocked networks, rate limits, redaction, and no-write proof.

roles.name: Website Intelligence Agent
roles.owns: Extraction quality, confidence/failure states, manual-evidence fallback, and live drift interpretation.

roles.name: Pilot Evidence Lead
roles.owns: Pilot rollout toggles, approved test sites, evidence checklist, and stop/go interpretation.

roles.name: Observability And Reliability Agent
roles.owns: Logs, metrics, trace IDs, cache hit rate, latency, failure-state dashboards, and alert thresholds.

roles.name: Regression Guard Agent
roles.owns: Validator gates and no-regression proof across drawer, resolver, SuiteScript, N/LLM, and write boundaries.

hostedEndpointPlan.runtime: Node.js service or serverless function with controlled egress
deploymentShape: Dedicated no-write resolver service outside Tampermonkey and outside SuiteScript.
Drawer calls endpoint through W64 adapter using window/localStorage endpoint toggle during pilot.
No NetSuite credentials, no NetSuite cookies, no SuiteScript URLs, no record IDs, and no write tokens accepted.
environmentTiers: staging resolver endpoint with approved live smoke
pilot resolver endpoint allowlisted for five consultants

auth: Require short-lived resolver API token or signed request header for pilot.
Rotate pilot token before broader rollout.
Reject requests with NetSuite session cookies or authorization headers from NetSuite.
Do not use N/LLM credentials or NetSuite credentials in resolver.
cors: Allow only approved NetSuite account origins during pilot.
Allow local preview origin only in development.
Respond to preflight with POST and Content-Type only.
requestRedaction: Store only manualEvidence excerpt hashes and short trace-safe excerpts.

doNotCache: blocked-domain security decisions beyond aggregate metrics
cacheInvalidation: cache corruption or bad extraction rollback

retryPolicy: One delayed retry for transient 5xx or network reset.
No retry after timeout inside live consultant flow; return timeout and allow manual retry.
Retry never changes write authority or confidence state.

redirectPolicy: Re-check scheme and DNS after every redirect.

alerts: timeout rate above 20 percent during pilot

whenUsed: approved live site drift prevents sufficient public extraction
rules: Manual evidence may improve extraction and confidence but must be displayed as consultant-supplied.
Manual evidence cannot hide blocked/timeout fetch status.
Manual evidence must be included in trace as excerpt/hash, not full sensitive notes.

killSwitches: disable resolver endpoint and return to local fallback
disable local fallback and force manual evidence confirmation

deploymentChecklist: Configure strict CORS for approved NetSuite account origins.
Configure pilot API token or signed request header.
Enable metrics and trace logging with redaction.
Run W65 approved live smoke from staging.
Run W66 extraction gap closure harness against staging trace.
Configure drawer endpoint toggle for pilot users only.
Verify Plan/Review failure-state UX for blocked, thin, unavailable, timeout.
Verify no SuiteScript invocation and no write fields accepted.
Capture rollback baseline and endpoint kill switch.
rollbackPlan: Set local fallback toggle according to pilot stop condition.
Preserve trace exports for failed runs.
Revert resolverVersion/extractionPolicyVersion if bad extraction shipped.
Do not retry writes because resolver has no write authority.

goIf: W65/W66 staging smoke has zero false-confident-wrong.
Failure states are visible in Plan and Review.
Consultants can provide manual evidence for blocked/thin sites.
Endpoint can be killed without changing drawer code.
noGoIf: Trace omits resolver failure state or source URLs.
